## Description and Rationale

I'm obsessed with using graph theory to structure data. I have two patents pending for creative applications on my theories in graph data in the fields of cyber security and neural networks in AI.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: United Kingdom
* Number of team members: 1

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(gt)

gt(tibble::tribble(
  ~id, ~forename,   ~surname,             ~affiliation,
   1L, "Richard", "Benfield", "Independent Researcher"
)
) |> cols_label(id = md("**ID**"), forename = md("**Forename**"), surname ~ md("**Surname**"), affiliation ~ md("**Affiliation**"))
```
